title: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Convergence to Generalized Nash Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2411.15036v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has achieved notable success in cooperative tasks, demonstrating impressive performance and scalability. However, deploying MARL agents in real-world applications presents critical safety challenges. Current safe MARL algorithms are largely based on the constrained Markov decision process (CMDP) framework, which enforces constraints only on discounted cumulative costs and lacks an all-time safety assurance. Moreover, these methods often overlook the feasibility issue (the system will inevitably violate state constraints within certain regions of the constraint set), resulting in either suboptimal performance or increased constraint violations. To address these challenges, we propose a novel theoretical framework for safe MARL with $\textit{state-wise}$ constraints, where safety requirements are enforced at every state the agents visit. translated_title: 收敛于广义纳什均衡的安全多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在协作任务中取得了显著成功，展现出出色的性能与可扩展性。然而，将MARL智能体部署到现实应用中会带来关键的安全挑战。当前的安全MARL算法大多基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）框架，该框架仅对折扣累积代价施加约束，缺乏全程的安全保障。此外，这些方法往往忽视了可行性问题（即系统在约束集的某些区域内将不可避免地违反状态约束），从而导致性能次优或约束违反增多。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个新颖的基于状态级（state-wise）约束的安全MARL理论框架，其中安全要求在智能体所访问的每一个状态上都被强制执行。为解决可行性问题，我们利用了一种控制论方法……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个带有状态级安全约束的新型安全多智能体强化学习理论框架，通过控制论方法解决可行性问题并保证全程安全，同时证明了算法收敛于广义纳什均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel theoretical framework for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning with state-wise safety constraints that addresses the feasibility issue via a control-theoretic approach and provably converges to a generalized Nash equilibrium.
